title: real-1 read TES company info
prompt: Use Paperclip API: GET /api/companies/78678df7-e2c2-4bea-9503-67300871acb9. Report the company name and issuePrefix as a comment. Then set status to done.

title: real-2 list open issues
prompt: GET /api/companies/78678df7-e2c2-4bea-9503-67300871acb9/issues?status=todo,in_progress and report how many open issues exist plus list their titles in one comment. Then set status to done.

title: real-3 fibonacci 15
prompt: Compute the 15th Fibonacci number (F0=0, F1=1, so F15=610). Post the answer in one comment formatted as: 'F(15) = <number>'. Then set status to done.

title: real-4 reverse-string code
prompt: Write a Python function reverse(s: str) -> str that returns the reverse of s WITHOUT using slicing (no s[::-1] and no reversed()). Post the source code in a comment inside a python code fence. Then set status to done.

title: real-5 list local files
prompt: Run a shell command to list 5 entries in ~/Documents (or %USERPROFILE%\Documents on Windows). Post just the names in a comment. Then set status to done.

title: real-6 system info
prompt: Run two shell commands: 'node --version' and 'echo OS=%OS%' (or 'uname -s' on Linux). Post the two outputs in a comment. Then set status to done.

title: real-7 fetch example.com
prompt: Fetch https://example.com using curl or any HTTP client you have. Extract the page TITLE (between <title> and </title>). Post the title text in a comment. Then set status to done.

title: real-8 prime check
prompt: Of these numbers: 17, 24, 31, 42, 53 — which ones are prime? Post the list of primes in a comment, sorted ascending. Then set status to done.

title: real-9 SQL injection explain
prompt: Explain in one comment (3 short sentences max) what SQL injection is and how parameterized queries prevent it. Then set status to done.

title: real-10 identity check
prompt: GET /api/agents/me using your PAPERCLIP_API_KEY. Post your agent name and id in a comment. Then set status to done.
